protocol.labels: Read only after inference, event generation and reference identity; no relabeling or exclusions
protocol.input: Original continuous96k audio; same causal147/640 FIR and past-only windows; no delay compensation or right padding
protocol.decoder: Unchanged forward-only .5 onset/.3 frame, attack3/release3, no active retriggers, offline duration filter or Melodia
protocol.paired_change: Both arms use exact crop164/165. Change only the minimum and maximum-offset time reductions from frames0:172 to144:172; all frequency bins and all learned weights unchanged. No rescale, clip or threshold tuning.
protocol.primary_clock: Same measured serial FIFO completion for both arms including both model calls, resampling and independent decoders. This is a controlled paired clock, not a single-arm deployment estimate.
protocol.diagnostic_clock: Same event sequence at input-block availability, zero-compute diagnostic only; never substitute for primary verdict
protocol.comparison: Distinct pitch occupancy at full original recording horizon, full pitch range21..108; per-label present/longest and band totals, wrong/gap extras, complete/exact pitch sets, event pairing/EOF
protocol.incremental_screen: Ordinary pitch-coverage gain>0pp versus same-pass reference AND both datasets pass no_pitch_safety_regression: zero per-label present/longest loss, no wrong/gap increase, no complete/exact pitch-set loss.
protocol.current_comparison: Report strict saved CURRENT comparison separately; no installed promotion from this two-recording screen
protocol.reference_identity: Before scoring: note/onset maximum absolute error<=1e-5 against run44889388628; exact frame map, event kinds/pitches/frame/source-availability and decoder EOF state. Crop pinned by SHA256.
protocol.mechanism: Retain each window minimum/range for both arms and changed counts; this tests normalization support, not a guaranteed recovery of all context loss.
protocol.risk: Training used full-window normalization; recent support shifts the feature distribution and can add false outputs or lose notes.
protocol.stop: No tuning, automatic retry, sweep or promotion after a quality rejection; retain full evidence and make the next decision from the result.
protocol.scope: CPU inference only on GitHub; no native plugin/allocation/deadline, guitar attack-latency, host/device, lane/unison/bend acceptance
protocol.bulk_policy: Keep bulk remote, collect the small report once
